niveau.label: PREREQUISITES
niveau.title: MINIMUM LEVEL
niveau.p1_prefix: The required level depends on the discipline.
niveau.p1_strong1: Wrestling Camp in Dagestan: minimum 1 year of practice and a real ground game base
niveau.p1_middle: (wrestling, grappling, BJJ, judo or MMA). Instruction happens by demonstration, at the local pace: the ground base is what lets you follow.
niveau.p1_strong2: MMA Camp in Chechnya: Advanced level minimum
niveau.p1_suffix: (more than 5 years of regular practice) or Competitor, because the local sparring partners are professional fighters.
niveau.p2: In both cases the camp is intense. If you arrive without physical preparation, you will not last the first week. We therefore provide you with a 6-week preparation program.

checklist.title: PRE-DEPARTURE CHECKLIST
items: Complete 50 bodyweight squats in a row
Regular sparring (1 to 2 times per week)

week1.desc: Aerobic base. Running 30 to 45 min, swimming, cycling. Initial Cooper test.

week2.desc: Squats, pull-ups, push-ups, deadlifts. Functional circuits.

week3.desc: Yoga, dynamic stretching, hip and shoulder work.

week5.desc: Strength and cardio combination. 45-minute circuits. Live sparring.

week6.desc: Reduced volume, intensity maintained. Active rest. Mental preparation.

vetements.title: Combat and protection
items: Wrestling shoes (bring your own, strongly advised against buying them on site)

hygiene.title: Clothing, hygiene and documents
items: Passport (valid 6+ months) and printed e-visa documents (sent by MKR)
Cash in euros to exchange on site (bank cards do not work)

mental.label: MENTAL
mental.title: MENTAL PREPARATION
mental.p1: The language barrier, the culture shock, the physical discomfort: the camp will push you out of your comfort zone. That is the point. The best fighters in the world have trained in these conditions since childhood.
mental.p2: Do not expect a 5-star hotel. The lodging is simple, the food is abundant but rustic, and the coaches will not go easy on you. If you are looking for comfort, this camp is not for you. If you are looking for progress, you are in the right place.
mental.quote: "One month of camp that is worth two years in a regular gym. The Dagestanis teach you to suffer with a smile."
